title: Supreme Court announces court suspension in some areas on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026
summary: The Supreme Court has announced that court operations in some areas in the country are suspended on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 due to the ASEAN Summit and power interruption.

blocks.text: The Supreme Court has announced that court operations in some areas in the country are suspended on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 due to the ASEAN Summit and power interruption.
The operations of the following courts are suspended:

items: Supreme Court and Offices of the Regional Court Managers in NCR-A and NCR-B - 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits
Court of Appeals-Manila - 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits
Sandiganbayan - 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits
Court of Tax Appeals - 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits
All courts within the National Capital Judicial Region - 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits
MTC Carrangalan, Nueva Ecija - power interruption
All courts in San Jose City, Nueva Ecija - power interruption
All courts in Baao, Buhi, Nabua, Bula, and Iriga in Camarines Sur - power interruption
RTC Branch 27 and 4th MCTC Siocon-Baliguian-Sirawaii in Siocon, Zamboanga del Norte - power interruption

blocks.text: The Supreme Court also posted OCA Circular No. 224-2026, the following guidelines shall be followed:

items: The filing of initiatory and non-initiatory pleadings in criminal cases is temporarily suspended. Consequently, the respective deadlines will be moved to the next working day.

The filing of initiatory pleadings personally, through registered mail or by accredited courier in civil cases is likewise temporarily suspended, and the respective deadlines are moved to the next working day.

However, under Rule 13-A (Interim Rule on the Electronic Filing and Service of Pleadings, Judgements, and other Papers in Civil Cases) of the Rules of Court, non-initiatory pleadings in civil cases shall still be transmitted through digital file format through email.
